[element-conf-sponsor]
=== `<conf-sponsor>` Conference Sponsor (in a citation)

Within a citation (such as a <<element-mixed-citation,`<mixed-citation>`>> or an <<element-element-citation,`<element-citation>`>>), one organization identified as a sponsor of a conference.

#### Usage/Remarks
If more than one organization sponsored the conference, use a separate <<element-conf-sponsor,`<conf-sponsor>`>> element for each one.

#### Attributes

* <<attribute-content-type,`@content-type`>>
* <<attribute-specific-use,`@specific-use`>>
#### Base Attributes

* <<attribute-id,`@id`>>
* <<attribute-xml-base,`@xml:base`>>
* <<attribute-xml-lang,`@xml:lang`>>

#### Models and Context

#### May be contained in

<<element-element-citation,`<element-citation>`>>, <<element-mixed-citation,`<mixed-citation>`>>, <<element-related-article,`<related-article>`>>, <<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>>
#### Description

Any combination of: Text, numbers, or special characters <<element-institution,`<institution>`>> <<element-institution,Institution Name>> <<element-institution-wrap,`<institution-wrap>`>> <<element-institution-wrap,Institution Wrapper>>
